{{Top|leg}}
The '''Interim Constitution''' was the agreement signed between the [[Gorothite/Legends|Gorothite]] [[P'Dar'Ken]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Under the agreement&mdash;which was signed under duress by the P'Dar'Ken&mdash;the Galactic Empire was officially an advisory body to the native government. In reality, the Empire had complete control of the planet, with the P'Dar'Ken acting as a figurehead.
